capabilities: Upload note or folder attachments to an S3-compatible bucket
Rewrite embed links to public URLs and optionally trash local files
Download remote assets back into the vault and restore local links
Browse bucket objects by month in a gallery with preview, insert, and download
Convert wikilinks to markdown links and back, syntax only
disambiguation: Not a vault sync tool; it only moves attachment files to a bucket and rewrites their links.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that recursive folder commands can process the whole vault and shows a confirm dialog first; R2 setup details live in a separate docs/r2-setup.md file.
problem: Obsidian keeps all attachments inside the vault, so images, video, and other media bloat vault size and sync load.

relations.evidence: Cloudflare R2 is the documented target. Other S3-compatible providers work

requires.name: S3 access key and secret key

summary: Attachment offloader that uploads vault media to an S3-compatible bucket, rewrites note links to public URLs, and downloads files back local on demand.
